The '''Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences''' ([[Polish language|Polish]]: ''Instytut Matematyczny Polskiej Akademii Nauk'') is a research institute of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (PAN) headquartered in [[Warsaw]] at 8 Śniadeckich Street.<ref name=webPage>[https://www.impan.pl/pl/wydawnictwa/impan Instytut Matematyczny official web page]{{Dead link|date=September 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} Polish Academy of Sciences</ref>

==History==
It was established on November 20, 1948 as the National Mathematical Institute and in the same year the Mathematical Devices Group (Polish: ''Grupa Aparatów Matematycznych'') was established there, and this can be considered the beginning of computer science in Poland.<ref name=Elwro>[http://www.starekompy.pl/800.html The educational computer Elwro 800 Junior] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120327180615/http://www.starekompy.pl/800.html |date=2012-03-27 }}  (in Polish)</ref> According to a 1945 project by [[Karol Borsuk]], [[Bronisław Knaster]] and [[Kazimierz Kuratowski]], the institute is subdivided into sections corresponding to the major branches of mathematics.<ref name="impanhist">{{Cite web |url=https://www.impan.pl/en/insitute/about-us/history |title=History |website=impan.pl |access-date=7 December 2024 |archive-date=25 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241225182045/https://www.impan.pl/en/insitute/about-us/history |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1952, it was incorporated into the structures of the Polish Academy of Sciences. The institute conducts doctoral studies in the field of mathematics and is located at 8 Śniadeckich Street in the [[Śródmieście, Warsaw|Śródmieście District]] of [[Warsaw]]. 

Over the course of its history, a number of prominent Polish mathematicians were employed by the institute including [[Stanisław Gołąb]], [[Kazimierz Kuratowski]], [[Franciszek Leja]], [[Edward Marczewski]], [[Stanisław Mazur]], [[Andrzej Mostowski]], [[Władysław Orlicz]], Witold Pogorzelski, [[Wacław Sierpiński]], [[Hugo Steinhaus]] and [[Tadeusz Ważewski]].<ref name="impanhist"/>

In 1972, the institute saw the establishment of the International Stefan Banach Center. It hosts workshops and conferences with participation of both young mathematicians and specialists from different countries around the world.<ref name="impanhist"/>

==Structure==
The structure of the Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences (IMPAS).<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/institute/branches?layout=default</ref>
* '''Headquarters in Warsaw''': 8 Śniadeckich Street, 00-656 Warsaw 
* '''Gdańsk Branch''': 18 Abrahama Street, 81-825 Sopot
head – Prof. Tomasz Szarek
* '''Katowice Branch''': 14 Bankowa Street, 40-007 Katowice
head – Prof. Ryszard Rudnicki
* '''Kraków Branch''': 30 Świętego Tomasza Street, 31-027 Kraków
head – Dr hab. Michał Kapustka (IMPAN Prof.)
* '''Poznań Branch''': 87 Umultowska Street, 61-614 Poznań
Activities suspended 
* '''Toruń Branch''': 12 F. Chopina Street, 87-100 Toruń
head – Prof. Yuriy Tomilov 
* '''Wrocław Branch''': 18 Kopernika Street, 51-617 Wrocław
head – dr hab. Adam Nowak

Other IMPAN units:
* Stefan Banach International Mathematical Center<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/banach-center</ref>
* Będlewo Conference Centre, near Poznań<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/other-information/bedlewo-conference-center?layout=default</ref>
* Research Centres<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/research-centers</ref>:
   * Dioscuri Centre for Topological Data Analysis<ref>https://dioscuri-tda.org/</ref>
   * Centre for Applications of Mathematics<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/research-centers/mathematical-center-for-science-and-technology</ref>
* Central Mathematical Library – its collections include more than 80,000 volumes of books and over 85,000 volumes of journals. The Library provides readers with access to more than 5,000 electronic mathematics books and approximately 12,000 scientific electronic journals.<ref>http://im.katalog.pan.pl/ipac20/ipac.jsp?profile=impanwa--1&x=4&y=11</ref>

==Awards==
The Institute presents the following awards<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards?layout=default</ref>:

* The Stefan Banach Medal<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/the-stefan-banach-medal</ref>
* Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences Prize for outstanding scientific achievements in mathematics<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/institute-of-mathematics-of-the-polish-academy-of-sciences-prize-for-outstanding-scientific-achievements-in-mathematics</ref>
* [[Kuratowski_Prize|Kazimierz Kuratowski Prize]]<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/the-kazimierz-kuratowski-award</ref>
* The Director of IM PAN Award for Distinguished Doctoral Theses (formerly the Marek Wacławek Foundation Awards)
* Barbara and Jaroslav Zemánek prize<ref>https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/barbara-and-jaroslav-zemanek-prize</ref>
